title: Verify: independent outcome checks
summary: Checks run from the dispatcher tick (a non-agent process) on commitments in done: http, json path, file digest and a second-model-family judge (pending-human / needs-station when no station is reachable). Pass moves the commitment to verified, fail back to in_progress with the failure; every result lands in company/work/verify/results.jsonl. The seat that did the work can never mark it verified.
enableWhen: you are paid or blamed on claims

tools.purpose: independent checks on done commitments: verified, or back to in_progress with the failure

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner

meters.why: every verification result; the record evidence exports
